card.name: Macrolide antibiotics in CYP3A4 interactions
card.fires_on: The ending of the word macrolide ("ide" after "macrol") in lists of CYP3A4 inhibitors. It also fires on words in drug lists that follow, such as "other" before macrolides and "phen" in phenobarbital.

modes.label: Macrolide class name
modes.description: The final piece of "macrolide" before the word antibiotics in interaction warnings.
modes.example: Concomitant use of APADAZ with a CYP3A4 inhibitor, such as macrol<<ide>> antibiotics (e.g., erythrom

modes.label: Other CYP3A4 drug lists
modes.description: Words inside lists of enzyme inducers or macrolides, such as "other" or the start of phenobarbital.
modes.example: Inducers of CYP3A4 such as St. John’s wort ( Hypericum perforatum ) preparations,<< phen>>obarbital, carbamazep

card.plain: It marks the macrolide antibiotic name in drug-interaction warnings about enzyme inhibitors and inducers.
